immutable_v21_evidence.evidence_limit: Only the published result and public static source/metadata were read. No sealed tensor bytes or hidden harness/golden output were inspected. Aggregate V21 metrics do not identify the individual rows responsible for G1's ten-match regression.

formulas.all_hard_gates_pass: logical AND of all nine hard-gate pass values

g1_relative_to_g2.observed_conclusion: G1 improves every published rank-margin and aggregate score-error measure relative to G2, yet loses ten top-key matches. Aggregate error reduction is therefore not sufficient for exact row-wise argmax preservation.

strict_observations: Rank-margin violation count decreases 70, 40, 18, 8 as groups become finer.
Minimum realized margin remains negative for every candidate, proving at least one strict oracle-top ordering failure at each granularity.
Sum absolute error and sum squared error strictly decrease from G8 through G1.
Sum signed error is negative for every candidate and moves monotonically toward zero as groups become finer.
Maximum absolute error is not monotonic: G4 is 513664 Q12.20 LSB worse than G8 before improving at G2 and G1.
Top-key matching improves through G2 and then regresses at G1.
cross_candidate_trends.population_caveat: Top-key metrics cover all 574 causal rows. Rank-margin metrics cover only the 346 nonsingleton rows with one exact oracle maximum. The aggregate result cannot determine whether G1's ten lost top matches are oracle-tied rows, different unique-top rows, or a mixture; no row-level claim is justified.

mechanism_assessment.observed_fact: Finer grouping reduces aggregate score error and rank-margin violations, while the evaluator uses exact integer BF16 decomposition, round-to-nearest ties-to-even, exact integer products, and one Q12.20 realization boundary.
mechanism_assessment.hypothesis_or_limit: The published aggregates show approximation error but cannot distinguish intended 8-bit quantization loss from an arithmetic implementation defect.
mechanism_assessment.discriminator: Exhaustive public finite-BF16 encoding checks and an independent rational/integer dot-and-normalization oracle.

mechanism_assessment.observed_fact: G8 to G2 improves top-key accuracy, rank margins, absolute error, and squared error as exponent sharing decreases. G1 eliminates cross-lane exponent sharing but still has 144 top mismatches and 8 margin violations.
mechanism_assessment.hypothesis_or_limit: Shared exponents contribute at G8/G4/G2, but residual G1 failure cannot be attributed to cross-lane grouping.
mechanism_assessment.discriminator: Compare each grouped candidate to a source-Q/K identity control and to G1 on the same rows in a future separately authorized diagnostic.

mechanism_assessment.observed_fact: Every candidate reports zero saturation events; the frozen encoder rejects clamp/saturation and uses independent RNE quantization of Q and K. G1 still rounds each BF16 lane to an 8-bit mantissa.
mechanism_assessment.hypothesis_or_limit: Independent operand rounding is a plausible residual source and can produce non-monotonic argmax behavior near small row margins. Saturation is not supported as a V21 cause.
mechanism_assessment.discriminator: Public tie-boundary and near-tie vector regressions plus future row-level identity-versus-G1 residual counts.

mechanism_assessment.observed_fact: The format is symmetric grouped BFP with no affine zero-point. The score path applies exact HEAD64 scale 1/8 and Q12.20 through exponent offset +17. All realized rows satisfy nonpositive centering.
mechanism_assessment.hypothesis_or_limit: Negative signed error alone does not prove scale bias because both oracle and realized rows are independently maximum-centered. A frozen-reference accumulation or casting difference remains unresolved.
mechanism_assessment.discriminator: Independent public scale/centering oracle and future unquantized source-Q/K identity control against the frozen oracle.

mechanism_assessment.observed_fact: V21 resolves records by tensor_name, rejects duplicate/missing/unexpected names, requires the canonical k/q/oracle set, passes the full 25-record V18 table to the worker, and the evaluator closes all expected metric populations.
mechanism_assessment.hypothesis_or_limit: No published evidence points to a remaining mapping-order defect. The sealed bytes were intentionally not reopened, so content identity is accepted from immutable hashes rather than independently reverified here.
mechanism_assessment.discriminator: Retain six-permutation and duplicate/missing/unexpected-name public regressions; any failure rejects V22 before authority.

mechanism_assessment.observed_fact: The evaluator forms exact grouped integer dot terms, aligns exponents, applies HEAD64 scale and Q12.20 rounding, centers each row, and compares against separately decoded BF16 qk_scaled_scores.
mechanism_assessment.hypothesis_or_limit: The published result contains no unquantized source-Q/K control, so it cannot show whether reconstruction from BF16 Q/K already differs from the frozen score tensor before quantization.
mechanism_assessment.discriminator: Add a nonselecting identity-control sidecar in a future separately authorized V22 experiment while leaving the official V1 result unchanged.

mechanism_assessment.observed_fact: No V21 candidate meets exact 1/1 top matching, zero top mismatches, zero margin violations, and 1/1 unique-margin preservation. G1 is the finest available grouping and still fails all four ranking gates.
mechanism_assessment.hypothesis_or_limit: This proves no current V8 G8/G4/G2/G1 implementation passes; it does not prove the thresholds are mathematically infeasible for every fixed-contract successor.
mechanism_assessment.discriminator: If an unquantized source-Q/K identity control fails the same oracle ranking gates, quantizer-only repair is infeasible under the frozen score reconstruction. If it passes, the thresholds remain achievable in principle and quantization is causal.

mechanism_assessment.observed_fact: The oracle is the frozen BF16 qk_scaled_scores tensor; the evaluator does not recompute the oracle from Q/K. All candidate signed-error sums are negative but improve toward zero with finer grouping.
mechanism_assessment.hypothesis_or_limit: The sign trend is compatible with quantization loss and also with source-score accumulation/casting differences. Aggregate metrics cannot choose between them.
mechanism_assessment.discriminator: Compare exact unquantized BF16 Q/K reconstruction to the frozen BF16 oracle before evaluating any repair.

Reject malformed, duplicate, missing, or unexpected tensor names and emit canonical k/q/oracle ordering independent of mapping insertion order.
After exactly-once ownership, read the official payload once, bind result identities, and call the production bridge.
Create the canonical payload/binding/context envelope and invoke the bound worker with exact argv, cwd, and environment.
Spawn once without a shell, require clean stdout/stderr/return code, validate schema and bound record, then publish immutable result bytes.
Require exact package/acceptance/action and full V18 binding table equality, decode the one payload envelope, load the frozen parser/evaluator, and call evaluate_bundle_once.

production_path_trace.function: finite scan; encode; dot; normalize; oracle; thresholds; result sealing; evaluate_bundle_once
production_path_trace.semantics: Cross-parse the exact bundle, evaluate G8/G4/G2/G1 with canonical grouped-BFP8 arithmetic, compare to the frozen BF16 oracle, derive nine hard gates, select the first full pass, and self-seal canonical result bytes.

identity.identity_suffix_source: first eight hexadecimal characters of the immutable published V21 result file SHA-256

v22_static_successor.narrowest_semantically_justified_change: Add independently checkable public/synthetic arithmetic regressions and specify a future nonselecting source-Q/K identity-control diagnostic sidecar. Do not change the frozen official evaluator result, candidate implementations, candidate order, hard gates, score policy, or selection policy until the identity control attributes the residual error.

hypotheses.statement: The production grouped-BFP8 integer implementation disagrees with an independent exact public arithmetic oracle.
hypotheses.reject_if: All exhaustive scalar, group exponent, pack/unpack, dot, normalization, tie, and Q12.20 public regressions agree exactly.

hypotheses.statement: Shared exponents are the dominant G8/G4/G2 error contributor.
hypotheses.reject_if: Grouped-to-G1 residuals do not shrink as sharing decreases on public and future bound row diagnostics.

hypotheses.statement: Independent 8-bit operand rounding is the residual G1 cause and can improve aggregate error while worsening selected row argmaxes.
hypotheses.reject_if: The source-Q/K identity control fails before quantization, or G1 is bit-exact to identity on failing rows.

hypotheses.statement: Exact unquantized BF16 Q/K reconstruction under the frozen score path disagrees with frozen BF16 qk_scaled_scores because of accumulation, casting, scale, or reference-generation semantics.
hypotheses.reject_if: The identity control has zero top mismatches, zero unique-margin violations, and zero score error against the frozen oracle.

hypotheses.statement: A tensor-role mapping error remains after V21's order-independent binding repair.
hypotheses.reject_if: All name permutations and binding identities close and the identity control uses the exact frozen records/hashes.

public_or_synthetic_regressions_required: Exhaust all 65280 finite BF16 words for sign, subnormal, normal, signed-zero, RNE tie, exponent, and G1 encode/decode agreement against an independent integer oracle.

Exercise G8/G4/G2/G1 group-exponent minimality with zero, boundary, extreme-dynamic-range, and permutation-generated 64-lane public vectors; reject any clamp, saturation, reserved -128 mantissa, or noncanonical exponent.
Require pack/unpack byte-exact round trips for all generated grouped heads.

Compare grouped_dot_score_pair and normalize_score_row_q12_20 to an independent Python Fraction/integer oracle, including cancellation, mixed exponents, underflow rounding, exact ties, and lowest-key-index tie breaking.
Verify HEAD64 scale 1/8 plus Q12.20 exponent offset +17 and maximum centering with hand-derived public vectors; zero-point behavior must remain absent.

Generate a deterministic public near-tie corpus that includes at least one witness where G1 has lower aggregate score error than G2 but a worse top key, proving that the V21 non-monotonic pattern is arithmetically possible without invoking the official payload.
Retain all six tensor-record insertion-order permutations plus duplicate, missing, unexpected, malformed, and altered-binding-table negative cases through the exact production binding resolver.
Static regressions must not open, inspect, deserialize, or hash-read the official tensor payload and must not start the official evaluator or create a runtime namespace.

future_separately_authorized_experiment_.diagnostic_sidecar: A separately schema-bound, nonselecting aggregate-only report may add an exact unquantized source-Q/K identity control and row-class counts/digests. It must expose no tensor values and cannot satisfy quantization acceptance.
controls: B0 identity: decode frozen BF16 Q and K exactly, perform the same HEAD64 scale, causal mask, row centering, tie rule, and Q12.20 realization with no grouped-BFP8 quantization, then compare to frozen BF16 qk_scaled_scores.
B1 existing G1: compare G1 to B0 to isolate per-lane 8-bit operand rounding from exponent grouping.
B2 grouped residuals: compare G2, G4, and G8 to G1/B0 to isolate additional shared-exponent effects.

Publish only aggregate gate counts, signed/absolute/squared error totals, bounded row-class counts, and cryptographic digests under a new diagnostic schema; preserve the official V1 result byte semantics.
decision_rules: If B0 fails frozen-oracle top or margin gates, reject every quantizer-only repair under the current reconstruction and classify score/reference semantics before proposing another quantizer.
If B0 passes and B1 fails, attribute residual failure to per-lane 8-bit Q/K quantization/rounding; exponent grouping is not the G1 cause.
If B0 and B1 pass but coarser groups fail, exponent sharing is causal and a grouping repair may be justified.
If independent public arithmetic regressions disagree with production functions, repair the smallest mismatching arithmetic function before any official execution.
If binding regressions fail, stop at tensor mapping; do not interpret numerical results.

fail_closed_acceptance_criteria: Fresh-L2 independently recomputes every V21 gate and all successive deltas from the immutable result SHA-256 4901c835dd9b8700cb3a3dd5ecac54f2d1112f7f2f6e909a7ad37ee35ab8941f.
The frozen evaluator, benchmark package, input hashes, result schema, candidate order, hard gates, score policy, and selection policy match this artifact exactly.
All public/synthetic regressions are additive, deterministic, and payload/evaluator/runtime inert.

Any official tensor payload read or evaluator invocation during static V22 construction/review.
Any change to a hard threshold, candidate order, score-error selection policy, or official V1 result schema.
Any use of B0 identity or a software path as quantization completion.
Any claim that aggregate V21 metrics identify the ten G1 regression rows or prove a unique root cause.
